The key takeaways are: • The experimental unit capacity for Case #1 (AHRI 210/240 A Test) is the same Full as the rated capacity (4-Ton, 14.1 kW). This proves that the HP-TES unit running without TES does not experience degraded performance. • The same conclusion can be drawn from Case #6 (AHRI 210/240 F Test). Full • The HP-TES model predicts the overall system performance (heat load, compressor power) and compressor temperatures (suction, discharge) very well. • The main deviations are during system start-up, which is expected since the experimental data is measured at steady-state while the Modelica model assumes system start-up. However, the steady-state model performance matches very well, thus validating the model predictions.
